dict.string: With the calendar check switched on, BakePlanner reads your appointments while you plan a bake and tells you when one falls on kneading, shaping or the oven.
BakePlanner enters the steps of a plan into your calendar on request, so everyone sees when the oven is taken.
BakePlanner sends a shopping list to Reminders on request, into its own list “BakePlanner”.
In the hands-free bake mode BakePlanner listens for “next”, “back”, “done” and “read”, so you can go through the steps with dough on your hands. Speech is recognized on the device.
BakePlanner recognizes the spoken commands of the hands-free bake mode on the device.
BakePlanner sets alarms for the steps of your bake on request, which ring even when the iPhone is on silent.
